text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, cake's a must, and then pizza,
pasta, curry,
and hamburg steaks would
be nice too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't forget 'bout the sushi! Can't
have a
celebration without it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we make our own sushi
rolls? If
we get a bunch of ingredients,
it'll be fun. What
else...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Uh, before we get ahead of ourselves,
isn't this
gonna be a bit much? Maybe
your birthday might
be a good time to
practice some self-control.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, Oguri? Not a
peep outta
the birthday girl?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you perhaps not feeling well? You
shouldn't
push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just... Seeing you two rack your
brains
over something like this just for
me, I get this
feeling in my chest...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's almost like I've just had a filling
meal. I
feel content.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri... We're going to make lots and
lots of
food—just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gah! All right, no more talk of
self-control from
me! Go wild!
